facts.fact: CIPESA's 24 September 2026 article refers to the AI Bill, 2026 as proposing a Commissioner-maintained public register of high-risk AI models and as addressing synthetic political content, and to a prospective AI Commissioner; the article gives no tabling date, so the date is its publication date.
